Preferred ICT sessions

  • NY AM 08:30–11:00
  • NY PM 13:30–16:00
  • AM Silver Bullet 10:00–11:00
  • PM Silver Bullet 14:00–15:00

Session note: New York ET is the reference timezone. IST must be converted dynamically because the offset changes with US daylight saving time.

ICT models & market context

Models: OTE, FVG entry, Silver Bullet, SMT, ICT 2022 Model

Drivers: US real yields, Fed repricing, Breadth and index leadership, CPI / NFP / PCE, NQ–YM confirmation

News catalysts: CPI, PPI, NFP, PCE, GDP, FOMC, ISM, JOLTS

Start with the same HTF draw used for NQ. Compare relative strength at a key level; wait for a sweep and ES MSS before using an ES FVG/OTE entry.

Related markets: NQ, YM, RTY, ZN

Comparison discipline: NQ–ES–YM SMT; do not double risk with highly correlated index positions.
